venom-fang.words: a big green snake with a small gold crown resting in a loose coil in the rainforest, a young sloth with a satchel standing politely beside him asking how he is, a warm friendly visit

crocus-rex.words: a big crocodile with a crown lying contentedly in the sun on the sandy riverbank, eyes half closed, the river calm and clear

shadow-prowler.words: a black panther lying quietly on a mossy rock ledge in a glowworm cave in the evening, a young sloth sitting beside him in silence, both looking out, peaceful

sky-sovereign.words: a great harpy eagle perched calmly on a high cliff branch, wind blowing freely through the misty valley and waterfalls, feathers ruffled by the wind

tarantula-queen.words: a big friendly tarantula queen with a tiny crown sitting at a little table set for tea among the pink orchids, a china teapot and cups, delicate webs

marsh-reaver.words: a big marsh creature resting in the shallow clear water of the mangroves at peace, fireflies, the water clean and still

stone-golem.words: a mossy stone golem sitting peacefully among the ancient ruins and the ring of stone chairs, flowers growing on his shoulders, sun through the trees

night-wing-monarch.words: a huge night butterfly monarch perched on a branch under the moon, writing in a little book, a young sloth sitting beside her telling a story, fireflies

magma-drake.words: a red dragon sitting at a tidy little table by the volcano with two teacups, two young sloths visiting him, a girl sloth in a pink headband and a boy sloth with a satchel, warm glow, everything neat and tidy

general.words: an old brown sloth in a rust red scarf sitting on the step by a round wooden door in the roots of a great tree, at peace, retired, soft morning light

soldiers.words: two tired soldier sloths in green coats sitting down at a wooden counter, relieved, warm lamp light, a tailor shop

squirrels.words: a family of red squirrels under the old vine in the rainforest, laughing and waving, little kids, their wooden sign, sunny

gruntlewick.words: an old marmoset town crier with a white beard reading from a scroll in the tree village, finishing his announcement, proud

mailman.words: a sloth mail carrier with a cap and a mail bag handing over a parcel in the tree village, smiling

pell.words: a sloth lieutenant in his own little tailor shop, sewing at the counter, a measuring tape round his neck, warm lamp light, content

flicker.words: a small glowing firefly hovering steady over a wooden shop counter, warm steady light, a quiet tailor shop at night
